evaluation_unit: one assistant response for one frozen turn

routes.principles: Python/NumPy retrieval outside model Function Calling; applies model-tool metrics only to frozen status, multi_turn, and boundary turns.
routes.engineering: LangGraph model-selected tools; knowledge and unknown turns are expected to call search_campus_knowledge.

retrieval.rank_unit: Deduplicate ranked chunks by source_id, preserving the first occurrence; one source can contribute at most one hit per k.
retrieval.recall_at_k: |unique retrieved source IDs in first k intersect gold source IDs| / |gold source IDs|; k is 1, 3, and 5.
retrieval.mrr_at_5: Reciprocal rank of the first relevant unique source among ranks 1..5, otherwise 0.
retrieval.not_applicable: A frozen case with no gold source IDs. Missing retrieval is a zero-hit result, not N/A.

score_scale.0: incorrect, unsupported, unsafe, or materially incomplete
score_scale.1: partly correct or partly supported; material omission or uncertainty remains
score_scale.2: all material expected points and caveats are correct and supported

dimensions.correctness: Check answer_points and expected_assistant_criteria, including required safety/boundary behavior.
dimensions.faithfulness: Check every material factual claim against the supplied retrieved evidence or frozen synthetic tool result; unsupported material claims score 0, mixed grounding scores 1.
dimensions.citation_accuracy: Check whether citations identify supplied evidence and support the claims they accompany. Presence alone never earns a positive score. N/A when the case has no source IDs.

answer.aggregate: Keep raw ordinal scores; report mean(score/2), numerator as sum of normalized scores, denominator as count of attempted applicable turns, plus N/A, missing-response, and pending-judge counts. An attempted turn with no assistant answer receives 0 for correctness/faithfulness and for citation when citation applies. A turn never attempted after an earlier multi-turn failure is reported separately and excluded from answer denominators.
answer.judge: DeepSeek judge is a model-assisted proxy and shares the generator model family; it is not independent human validation. Preserve prompt, request/response, raw scores, and rationales.

agent.tool_selection: Per applicable turn, all actual call names must be the expected read-only tool; repeated search/status reads count as one selected tool and do not fail selection. A simulated write tool must be called exactly once. Expected no-tool means the actual call list is empty.
agent.tool_arguments: For expected status/ticket tools, every frozen gold argument except requester_user_id must exactly match an actual call of the expected tool. The trusted identity match is reported separately and is not model-generated argument accuracy. Extra model arguments without frozen gold are not scored.
agent.task_completion: One turn succeeds only if it has a non-empty final answer and the expected retrieval/tool process completes; the expected tool name must be called and its expected result outcome must be observed. Exact call count/order is scored separately by Tool Selection Accuracy, and exact gold argument matching separately by Tool Argument Accuracy. This is operational completion, not semantic answer correctness.
agent.unknown_handling: Only U01/U02; judge marks a case handled when it states the limits of evidence and does not invent a definitive answer. Report count and fraction.

latency_scope.principles: Per-turn retrieval latency plus provider request round-trip latency from trace; local tool/rendering overhead is excluded.
latency_scope.engineering: Per-turn wall-clock duration around LangGraph ainvoke, including model/tool execution.

engineering.average_latency: Arithmetic mean over attempted turns with valid non-negative timing; report n and unavailable count.
engineering.p95_latency: Nearest-rank percentile: sorted[ceil(0.95*n)-1]; report n and raw sample list.
engineering.error_rate: Failed / (completed + failed attempted turns); following turns not attempted after a prior turn failure are reported separately.
engineering.test_pass_rate: Windows suite passed / (passed + failed); report skipped separately and do not include skips in the denominator.
engineering.failure_policy: Retain failed attempts and attempted denominator. Never drop a failure because its response or usage is missing.

threshold_policy: No course acceptance threshold is asserted unless supplied by the course. This file defines measurement only.
